title: Cannot find class in solution with multiple projects
body:
### Tested versions

4.3.stable.mono, 4.4.dev3.mono

### System information

Godot v4.4.dev3.mono - Windows 10.0.19044 - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 (NVIDIA; 30.0.14.7464) - AMD Phenom(tm) II X6 1055T Processor (6 threads)

### Issue description

Godot can't find class in other dll compiled from solution. Other scripts from other dll work.

Godot should load scenes as it would without projects inside. (No errors)

```
E 0:00:02:0989   NativeCalls.cs:2762 @ Godot.GodotObject Godot.NativeCalls.godot_icall_1_302(nint, nint, int): Cannot instantiate C# script because the associated class could not be found. Script: 'res://Core/MainMenu.cs'. Make sure the script exists and contains a class definition with a name that matches the filename of the script exactly (it's case-sensitive).
  <Ошибка C++>   Method/function failed. Returning: false
  <Исходный код C++>modules/mono/csharp_script.cpp:2303 @ can_instantiate()
  <Трассировка стека>NativeCalls.cs:2762 @ Godot.GodotObject Godot.NativeCalls.godot_icall_1_302(nint, nint, int)
                 PackedScene.cs:124 @ Godot.Node Godot.PackedScene.Instantiate(Godot.PackedScene+GenEditState)
                 Project.cs:9 @ void MRPMultipleProjects.Project._EnterTree()
                 Node.cs:2365 @ bool Godot.Node.InvokeGodotClassMethod(Godot.NativeInterop.godot_string_name&, Godot.NativeInterop.NativeVariantPtrArgs, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant&)
                 MRPMultipleProjects.Project_ScriptMethods.generated.cs:40 @ bool MRPMultipleProjects.Project.InvokeGodotClassMethod(Godot.NativeInterop.godot_string_name&, Godot.NativeInterop.NativeVariantPtrArgs, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant&)
                 CSharpInstanceBridge.cs:24 @ Godot.NativeInterop.godot_bool Godot.Bridge.CSharpInstanceBridge.Call(nint, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_string_name*, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant**, int, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant_call_error*, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant*)
```

MainMenu.tscn:
```
[gd_scene load_steps=2 format=3 uid="uid://boushih7da2o7"]

[ext_resource type="Script" path="res://Core/MainMenu.cs" id="1_qfhtu"]

[node name="MainMenu" type="Node"]
script = ExtResource("1_qfhtu")
```

Compiled MainMenu.cs without generating methods from godot:
```csharp
namespace MRPMultipleProjects.Core
{
	[ScriptPath("res://MainMenu.cs")]
	public class MainMenu : Node
	{
	}
}
```
Compiled Project.cs without generating methods from godot:
```csharp
namespace MRPMultipleProjects
{
	[ScriptPath("res://Project.cs")]
	public class Project : Node
	{
		public override void _EnterTree()
		{
			base.AddChild(ResourceLoader.Load<PackedScene>("res://Core/MainMenu.tscn", null, ResourceLoader.CacheMode.Reuse).Instantiate(PackedScene.GenEditState.Disabled), false, Node.InternalMode.Disabled);
			Tools.SomeMethod();
		}
	}
}
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open project
2. Run project

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mrp-multiple-projects.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/17481346/mrp-multiple-projects.zip)
